title: A Military ship without a weapon takes the Pulse Laser I it stored at Central Nexus out of storage and fits it again
note: Written by Apophis 2026-11-23 18:34 UTC (rule F2/F9: a hunter carries a weapon; F17: fitting is every class's own work). The miners' route strip-pulse-laser-central-nexus (Zero, for Voidborn miners) stood in the Military plan's First list, and five Voidborn hunters at Nexus Prime flew it between 14:48 and 17:57 UTC 2026-11-23 (table runs): each stored its only weapon there; two had no module left at all (ship files 18:30 UTC). One docked stop: withdraw the stored laser, fit it (the fit takes the copy aboard before any buy, max_price for the case none is aboard). requires.stored opens it only to a pilot whose storage there holds one; without_module only to a ship with no weapon. Once per pilot.
